notes.zh: 评注：玩家点击贸易站（楚尔罗盘）或某支车队的盾徽时打开；AI 只在每月检查（cara.333）中出现，需有通讯、能量储备及月收入足够，或“行商币”余额≥3000（events/caravaneer_events.txt:5639-5672）。从子菜单返回时同样回到本窗口（cara_home_return）。
notes.en: Commentary: opened when the player clicks the tradestation (Chor's Compass) or a fleet's shield; the AI only appears through the monthly check (cara.333): in communication, enough energy stock and income, or a CaravanCoinz balance of 3000+ (events/caravaneer_events.txt:5639-5672). Returning from a submenu comes back to this window (cara_home_return).

notes.zh: 评注：与行商处于敌对时尝试联系的替代窗口，只有“去死”一个选项（events/caravaneer_events.txt:270-330）。
notes.en: Commentary: the alternative window when contacting the caravaneers while hostile; its only option is "Die..." (events/caravaneer_events.txt:270-330).

notes.zh: 评注：老虎机一次消耗 2783.92 行商币；结果权重 70 坏1、15 坏2、4×3 小奖、1×3 大奖（其中一项需拥有远古遗物才可出）、1 特等奖（cara.210，events 553-577）。
notes.en: Commentary: one spin costs 2783.92 CaravanCoinz; outcome weights 70 bad-1, 15 bad-2, 4x3 small wins, 1x3 big wins (one needs an ancient relic), 1 jackpot (cara.210, events 553-577).

notes.zh: 评注：圣物箱一个 6194.21 行商币（或在“批量购买”状态下用能量，价格每次×1.05）。开箱抽取：1 迦拉特隆（全银河仅一件，已被持有则不出）、59 空箱、140 普通内容（14种，权重各100，唯一的“灵能统治者”特质项权重1）（events 915-977）。
notes.en: Commentary: a Reliquary costs 6194.21 CaravanCoinz (or energy once in bulk-buying mode, price x1.05 each time). The draw: 1 Galatron (only one in the galaxy; skipped if someone already holds it), 59 empty, 140 regular contents (14 kinds of weight 100, the psionic-ruler trait one only 1) (events 915-977).

notes.zh: 评注：抽中迦拉特隆后弹出，最后一个隐藏选项把遗物 r_galatron 加入帝国；遗物后续见 event-cara-970。
notes.en: Commentary: shown when the Galatron is drawn; the last hidden option adds the relic r_galatron to the empire; see event-cara-970 for the relic.

label.en: The three submenus of the main menu

note.zh: 玩家可以任意次序、反复进入老虎机、圣物箱和行商币菜单，每次都回到主菜单；另有三个“关于车队”的对话选项和一个结束通话选项。
note.en: The player may enter the slots, reliquary and CaravanCoinz menus in any order and repeatedly, each returning to the main menu; there are also three "about the fleet" dialog options and an end-communication option.

scope.zh: 主菜单与三个子菜单、敌对时的替代窗口、AI 访问条件及价格/权重均已核对。
scope.en: The main menu and its three submenus, the hostile alternative window, the AI visit condition, prices and weights were checked.

uncertain: The way CaravanCoinz are bought (cara.150) is a parody premium-currency menu; the real-money handling, if any, is engine-side.
